purpose: Point-in-time research, high-frequency feature pipelines, online/rolling model evaluation, backtesting and concept-drift patterns
latencySuitability: MEDIUM for research/replay; not selected for the live scanner hot path
securityNotes: Large ML dependency surface; do not place in browser or live ingestion hot path. Pin versions and isolate any future experiment in a challenger environment.
lookAheadRisk: MEDIUM unless point-in-time dataset semantics are enforced. Qlib has explicit point-in-time database and online/rolling concepts; TAGX must preserve event-time and never train on reconciled future snapshots.
dataCostRequirements: Framework itself does not solve authoritative US real-time data entitlement; external data remains required.
reason: Useful architecture for challenger research and replay, but too heavy and not latency-appropriate for TAGX live discovery. No direct dependency added.
